lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: I wish you the best in life.

lines.speaker: rane
lines.text: I'll wait for you! I promise!
Just as Jennifer opens the underground waterway and is about to slip inside,
the three of them hear the roar of a motorcycle approaching.
From the shadows of the dark alley emerge...
with Milk and Frima sitting in the back,
and three figures standing precariously on top.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Hurry up and get off. Black Typhoon can't take this weight.

lines.speaker: ce008_01
lines.text: It looks like we showed up right on time.
At Jennifer's signal, Jane and Rain open fire.

lines.speaker: ce008_01
lines.text: I can see it all coming.
Jane and Rain begin firing at Takina.
then starts to weave her way around.

lines.speaker: rane
lines.text: I knew it! She's just a normal human!
Takina sprints while dodging the gunfire...
And before they can even react, she's standing behind Jennifer with her gun aimed and ready.

lines.speaker: ce008_02
lines.text: A gun isn't something you just fire at random.

lines.speaker: ce008_02
lines.text: You should've watched where I was running and determined where I was headed.

lines.speaker: ce008_02
lines.text: Didn't your teacher teach you that?

lines.speaker: ce008_01
lines.text: So, what are you gonna do now?

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: If I'm caught, Jane and Rain will be devastated.
Don't worry. I can explain everything to them.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: All right. Then let's do it this way.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: Point your guns at each other's heads.
Without hesitation, Jane and Rain raise their guns and aim at each other.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: If you don't let me go, I'll make them shoot each other.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: Then Jane will die at her brother's hand,

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: and Rain will become someone who killed his own sister.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: if you don't let me go, at least one innocent life will be taken.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: People like you care about that kind of thing, don't you?
We have to protect Jane and Rain.
After all this, are we going to have to let her go free when she's right here in front of us...?

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: Now you can't run away, can you?

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: Want to know a secret, Miss Jennifer?

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: The kids with the bad scores were the ones getting adopted.

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: We knew better than anyone what each of the kids was each capable of.

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: I was okay with never getting adopted,

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: because I thought we were already a family.

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: I knew how dangerous and wrong it was to hurt others...!

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: I just thought that maybe it wasn't so bad if it meant we got to stay together!

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: ... But it looks like you didn't feel the same way.

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: You lied until the very end just so you could run away.
Jane raises her gun and aims it at Jennifer.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: I almost forgot I'd raised an attack dog.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: And quite well, if I do say so myself.

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: Did you never think you'd get bitten?

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: Shooting a stranger and shooting someone who felt like family are very different.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: ... Are you really going to throw away what little humanity you have left like this?
There's no need or reason to spill any more blood here.
I start to move in order to stop Jane from killing,
Chisato stretches out her arm and stops me.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: Are you really going to kill me? Hm?

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: I'm your one and only family...

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: You watched over me all this time,

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: and yet you don't know a single thing about me.

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: Thank you for raising me when I wasn't even your family.

lines.speaker: jennifer
lines.text: I don't want to die! Don't shoot!

lines.speaker: ce008_01
lines.text: Yeah, when I got my bag back, my gun wasn't in there.

lines.speaker: ce008_02
lines.text: You came without even looking for it?

lines.speaker: ce008_01
lines.text: I kinda had a feeling Jane was holding onto it.

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: ... I'm sorry I took it without asking.

lines.speaker: ce008_01
lines.text: Normally, I never let anyone use my gun,

lines.speaker: ce008_01
lines.text: but I'll make an exception just this once.

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: There's something I realized when I saw the gun you used on Rain.

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: The way to use a gun and not kill someone is easier than I thought.

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: What mattered most was... my choice.

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: That's why I had to borrow your gun.

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: Thank you for teaching me how to save people, and for lending me a gun that doesn't kill.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: So the gun Jane fired was Chisato's,

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: which means those two are just knocked out? No one's dead?

lines.speaker: ce008_01
lines.text: I'm sorry, I'm sorry! Let it slide just this one time, okay? Think of the children!

lines.speaker: ce008_02
lines.text: What am I supposed to do with you...?
Empty-handed, Jane walks over to Rain on the ground.

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: I didn't kill you because I chose not to.

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: I know why you were trying so hard,

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: because that's all we were ever taught.

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: We never learned how to help or save anyone.

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: If you want to stay trapped here, then you do that.

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: because now I know how not to kill.

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: I'm going to live an ordinary life.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: I'm guessing you won't be able to come to the cafe for a while.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: We'll be waiting. Drop by anytime.
Jane looks at us and, just as she always has,
she gives us a bright smile.
I turned the center and the kids over to Deputy Chief Andersen.
Then I spent all night submitting evidence and writing reports. I just now managed to get out.

lines.speaker: mast_t
lines.text: Here, have yourself a warm cup of coffee.

lines.speaker: ce008_02
lines.text: And here's a parfait with extra hot chocolate.

lines.speaker: ce008_02
lines.text: Yes. It's a dessert I came up with some time ago.
Right... Of course... Thanks for this. I'll, uh, dig in.

lines.speaker: mast_t
lines.text: I thought the cafe would only be closed for a day, so I came back the next morning...

lines.speaker: mast_t
lines.text: I thought everyone just went off to the market or something, so I went ahead and opened.

lines.speaker: mast_t
lines.text: Customers kept pouring in, but no one else came to help...!

lines.speaker: mast_t
lines.text: I ended up working till close all by myself for several days!

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: We were trying to do something good, and it just took longer than we thought.

lines.speaker: mast_t
lines.text: Next time, make sure you tell me first!

lines.speaker: ce008_03
lines.text: I'm glad things worked out and all, but when do we get to go back?
We've found the Gatekeeper. We just need to head to its location sometime soon.

lines.speaker: ce008_02
lines.text: Once we defeat the Gatekeeper, we'll be able to return home, correct?

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: What, you sad now that it's time to leave?

lines.speaker: ce008_01
lines.text: I really wish you all could come visit our world sometime.
We won't be leaving right this minute.
We still need to assess the situation, and there's a lot to prepare. It'll take some time.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Then I guess we'll just have to keep the business running till then!

lines.speaker: ce008_01
lines.text: Since today might be our last day, let's stay up all night playing board games!

lines.speaker: ce008_03
lines.text: Well, if you insist, then I guess I'll join you.

lines.speaker: ce008_02
lines.text: We open in exactly one minute.

lines.speaker: ce008_02
lines.text: We don't have time to be chatting like this.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: How in the heck did that happen?!

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Did you wipe down the tables?

lines.speaker: ce008_01
lines.text: I think we're short on ingredients!

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: I'll take Black Typhoon and go buy some.

lines.speaker: mast_t
lines.text: Let me hop on with you.

lines.speaker: mast_t
lines.text: I know exactly what we're missing.

lines.speaker: ce008_01
lines.text: The line's already insanely long! You'd think we'd been gone months...
Frima flips the sign on the door from "Closed" to "Open."
